speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: There were a lot of good things about the Industrial Revolution.

speaker: Unknown
en: It had a hugely positive impact on the world in many ways.
zh: 它在很多方面对世界产生了巨大的积极影响。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think a lot of people did not have a purely positive personal impact from that.
zh: 但我认为对很多人来说,那段经历带给他们个人的影响并非纯粹积极。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this feeling that people had these like rich lives and did all these things.
zh: 而这种感觉——人们曾过着这些丰富的生活,做了这么多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yeah, of course, they like struggled and wanted more and better stuff.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 就像机器上的齿轮,做着某种极其专门化的事情,并且某种程度上与让生活美好的许多部分脱节了。

speaker: Unknown

en: There's going to be no role for humans.

en: We're going to be like,

zh: 家猫一样,AI 会决定如何奖励我们、告诉我们该做什么。

en: I have heard people say that.
zh: 我确实听人这么说过。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's certainly not what we think.
zh: 那当然不是我们所认为的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I am hopeful for is that this is just a huge new wave of scientific discovery, art, company formation, like everybody that wants to start a new thing.
zh: 我所抱有希望的是,这会是一股巨大的科学发现、艺术、公司创立的新浪潮,就像每一个想开创新事物的人。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: But also people get to,

zh: 关于文艺复兴与工业革命,让我印象深刻的一点是,在文艺复兴时期,人们对「作为一个人、一个个体意味着什么」有一种不同的理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: as opposed to sort of the cog in the machine.
zh: 而不是机器上的齿轮。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

en: It's my favorite time of the day to work.

speaker: Unknown
